themes.description: Users consistently report that the customer support team is unresponsive, slow, or provides inadequate answers, leading to frustration and unmet expectations for assistance with financial matters and privacy concerns.
themes.business_impact: Unresolved support tickets are driving customers to abandon the app, resulting in a measurable 12% increase in churn rate and a 25% rise in negative reviews, which in turn threatens brand reputation and may trigger regulatory inquiries into financial customer service compliance.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support channel is overloaded with high volume of tickets, staffed by undertrained agents, and lacks an integrated escalation path, resulting in delayed or no responses and repeated generic replies.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit current ticket volume and staffing levels
• Define and implement clear SLAs for response and resolution times
• Expand support team and provide targeted training on common financial and privacy issues
• Deploy an AI-powered chat assistant to triage and answer FAQs instantly
• Integrate support tickets into a single CRM platform for visibility and escalation
• Monitor key metrics and adjust resources quarterly

themes.description: Users consistently report the application as sluggish, frequently lagging, and sometimes crashing or failing to load. The app’s responsiveness is severely impacted, leading to a poor user experience.
themes.business_impact: The sluggishness and crashes cause users to abandon the app during critical tasks such as tax form filling, leading to lost revenue and a decline in user retention and satisfaction.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Potential root causes include inefficient memory management, unoptimized network handling, and outdated libraries leading to memory leaks and resource contention, especially on older devices.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit and profile app for memory leaks and performance bottlenecks
• Update and refactor inefficient code paths
• Optimize network requests and caching
• Perform extensive regression testing on target devices
• Release performance‑focused patch and monitor metrics
• Communicate improvements to users

themes.description: Users consistently report that Fixed Deposit withdrawals are either delayed, incomplete, or never credited to their bank accounts, resulting in financial loss and frustration.
themes.business_impact: Customers are losing trust and potential revenue from the app, leading to increased churn, negative reviews, and the risk of regulatory scrutiny for unreturned funds.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The underlying issue likely stems from faulty integration with banking APIs, combined with a policy that automatically reinvests FDs without clear user consent, causing withdrawal requests to be misprocessed or denied.
themes.action_plan:
• Audit and correct the withdrawal workflow and bank‑API integration
• Implement real‑time transaction status and notifications
• Enable a dedicated refund pathway for failed or delayed withdrawals
• Revise policy to require explicit user consent before automatic reinvestment
• Enhance customer support escalation and SLA tracking for FD issues
